headline: Early reference: latest official benchmarks with effective dates. Nigeria parallel-market quotes could not be sourced for this edition (BLOCKED_SOURCE). Not live quotes.
nigeria_note: CBN selling rates are the latest available benchmarks, dated 24 Nov. Nigeria parallel-market observations could not be verified at preparation time and are not shown; no value is carried forward.

Ghana.note: Bank of Ghana interbank mid-rates, 24 Nov; mids read from the published table.

Kenya.note: CBK Daily KES commercial-banks' average closing rates, posted 24 Nov. Not a standalone buy or sell quote.

South Africa.note: SARB weighted-average bank rates, 23 Nov — carried forward: the SARB HomePageRates endpoint could not be reached (BLOCKED_SOURCE); true effective date shown.

Egypt.note: CBE official buy/sell mid-rates, 24 Nov, retrieved directly from the CBE table.

markets_note: Latest official reference values with effective dates: Ghana Bank of Ghana interbank mid-rates (24 Nov); Kenya CBK commercial-banks' average closing rates (posted 24 Nov; not a standalone buy or sell quote); South Africa SARB weighted-average bank rates (23 Nov, carried forward — source blocked); Egypt CBE official buy/sell mid-rates (24 Nov).
